maddeler.e:
يعتذرا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَذِرَا (yaʕtaḏirā) /jaʕ.ta.ði.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# يُعْتَذَرَا (yuʕtaḏarā) /juʕ.ta.ða.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
